title: How the Titanic Actually Sank: The Full Story
description:
On April 14th, 1912, the "unsinkable" RMS Titanic struck an iceberg in the North Atlantic and sank less than three hours later, killing over 1,500 people. This documentary breaks down exactly how it happened: the fatal design compromise in the ship's watertight compartments, the six iceberg warnings that didn't stop the crew, the ten seconds of impact that doomed the ship, and the chaotic, unequal scramble for too few lifeboats that followed.

We cover the maiden voyage from Southampton, the collision just before midnight, designer Thomas Andrews' grim verdict to Captain Smith, the outdated lifeboat regulations that left half the ship's passengers with no seat, the final sinking at 2:20 AM, the rescue by RMS Carpathia, and the sweeping maritime safety laws the disaster forced into existence — laws still in effect today. We also cover the 1985 discovery of the wreck by Robert Ballard's expedition, 73 years after it disappeared beneath the waves.

A factual look at one of the most famous maritime disasters in history, and why so much of it was preventable.
